map.弹性会随价格区间变吗？: Does Elasticity Change Across Price Bands?
map.会。低价区可能缺弹性、高价区变弹，宜在目标价位附近测算，勿外推过远。: Yes. The low-price band may be inelastic while the high-price band becomes elastic, so measure near your target price and do not extrapolate too far.
